# Requirements Quality Checklist: Soil Health Visualization

**Purpose**: Validate completeness, clarity, consistency, and coverage of visualization requirements before implementation
**Created**: 2026-09-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all four user stories (overlay, tooltip, hoe feedback, configuration) fully specified with acceptance scenarios? [Completeness, Spec §User Stories] — All 4 stories have acceptance scenarios (5/3/4/5 respectively)
- [x] CHK002 Are functional requirements defined for all rendering operations (overlay, tooltip, flash effect, floating text)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001 to FR-003] — FR-001 overlays, FR-002 tooltips, FR-003 flash + floating text
- [x] CHK003 Are configuration persistence requirements specified for both loading and saving operations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004 to FR-006] — FR-004 persist, FR-005 load on init, FR-006 fallback
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for independent toggling of each visualization feature (overlays, tooltips, hoe feedback)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007] — REMEDIATED: FR-007 now states "overlay rendering, tooltip rendering, and hoe feedback independently from each other"
- [x] CHK005 Are color interpolation requirements specified with explicit algorithm (linear RGB)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008] — "linear RGB interpolation" explicitly required
- [x] CHK006 Are viewport culling requirements defined for performance optimization? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009] — FR-009 requires viewport culling
- [x] CHK007 Are caching requirements specified including invalidation triggers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010] — Cache + invalidation on tile modification and save load specified
- [x] CHK008 Are event handler lifecycle requirements defined (registration and disposal)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012] — REMEDIATED: FR-012 now states "register all event handlers on mod initialization and unregister all event handlers on mod disposal"
- [x] CHK009 Are concurrency safety requirements specified for game event handling? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013] — FR-013 requires safe concurrent handling
- [x] CHK010 Are requirements defined for handling unavailable or unloaded soil health data? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014] — FR-014 requires neutral gray overlay
- [x] CHK011 Are all key entities from the spec (VisualizationConfiguration, SoilHealthTile, ColorMapping, TileOverlay, TooltipData, HoeFeedback) documented in the data model? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities, data-model.md] — REMEDIATED: SoilHealthTile entity added to data-model.md with fields (TilePosition, HealthValue, Category, IsTilled) and validation rules

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK012 Are health category thresholds explicitly defined (Poor 0-33, Moderate 34-66, Healthy 67-100)? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications] — "Poor: 0-33, Moderate: 34-66, Healthy: 67-100 (even thirds)"
- [x] CHK013 Are temporal durations quantified (flash 300ms, floating text 1000ms)? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications] — Flash: 300ms, floating text: 1000ms
- [x] CHK014 Is tooltip format explicitly specified ("Soil Health: {percentage}% ({category})")? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications] — Format string explicitly given
- [x] CHK015 Are accessibility patterns explicitly named (stripes, dots, solid) for each category? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications] — "stripes for poor, dots for moderate, solid for healthy"
- [x] CHK016 Is "invalid configuration" behavior specified (replace invalid values, preserve valid ones)? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications] — "Replace only invalid values with defaults, preserve valid ones"
- [x] CHK017 Are cache invalidation triggers explicitly listed (tile modification, save load)? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications] — "tile modification events, save load"
- [x] CHK018 Is frame rate target quantified (60 FPS, 16.67ms per frame)? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications] — "60 FPS (16.67ms per frame)"
- [x] CHK019 Is the "unknown" state visual representation specified (neutral gray overlay)? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications] — "neutral gray overlay indicating 'unknown' status"
- [x] CHK020 Is color interpolation method explicitly stated (linear RGB, not HSL/HSV)? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications] — "Linear interpolation in RGB space"
- [x] CHK021 Are category boundary handling rules defined (which category owns boundary values)? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Gap] — data-model.md: "Values at exact boundaries (33, 66) belong to the lower category"

- [x] CHK023 Are color category definitions consistent between functional requirements and clarifications? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §Clarifications] — Colors and patterns consistent across FR-001, Clarifications, data-model
- [x] CHK024 Are configuration fallback rules consistent across all config fields? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §User Story 4] — Per-field invalid→default, missing file→complete defaults, consistent across all sources
- [x] CHK025 Are event handler disposal requirements consistent with existing ModController patterns? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, plan.md] — FR-012 aligns with ModController infrastructure per plan.md and research.md
- [x] CHK026 Are performance targets consistent between success criteria and functional requirements? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002, §FR-009] — 60 FPS / 16.67ms / 1000 tiles consistent across SC-002, Clarifications, FR-009

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK033 Are requirements defined for the primary happy path (viewing overlays on tilled tiles)? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1] — FR-001 + US-1 acceptance scenarios fully cover happy path
- [x] CHK034 Are alternate flow requirements defined (tilling tiles with different health values)? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1] — US-1 scenarios cover poor/moderate/healthy/boundary values
- [x] CHK035 Are exception flow requirements defined (disabled features, invalid config)? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 4] — US-4 Scenarios 3-5 cover toggled-off, invalid values, missing file
- [x] CHK036 Are requirements defined for rapid mouse movement across tiles (tooltip flickering)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Gap] — REMEDIATED: FR-015 adds debounce requirement (min 50ms between tooltip updates)
- [x] CHK037 Are requirements defined for viewport/window resize scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Gap] — REMEDIATED: FR-016 adds recalculation within single frame on resize
- [x] CHK038 Are requirements defined for concurrent save/load operations with visualization state? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Gap] — REMEDIATED: FR-017 adds pause/resume rendering during save/load
- [x] CHK039 Are requirements defined for tiles at viewport edges? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Gap] — REMEDIATED: FR-018 adds partial overlay rendering with 1-tile margin
- [x] CHK040 Are requirements defined for configuration changes during active rendering? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Gap] — REMEDIATED: FR-019 adds atomic config application on next frame

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK041 Are requirements defined for health values at exact category boundaries (33, 34, 66, 67)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §Clarifications] — Clarifications define ranges; data-model confirms boundary ownership
- [x] CHK042 Are requirements defined for health values outside valid range (negative, >100, NaN)? [Edge Case, Gap] — data-model: "HealthValue clamped to [0, 100]" and "NaN/Infinity values default to Unknown category"
- [x] CHK043 Are requirements defined for soil health data failing to load? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-014] — FR-014 requires neutral gray overlay for unavailable data
- [x] CHK044 Are requirements defined for missing or corrupted configuration files? [Edge Case, Spec §User Story 4] — US-4 Scenarios 4-5 cover invalid values and missing files
- [x] CHK045 Are requirements defined for hoe usage on non-tilled tiles? [Edge Case, Spec §User Story 3] — US-3 Scenario 3: no feedback on non-tilled tiles
- [x] CHK046 Are requirements defined for mid-render health value changes? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases] — REMEDIATED: FR-020 adds frame consistency requirement (complete current frame with old state)
- [x] CHK047 Are requirements defined for zero tilled tiles (empty farm)? [Edge Case, Gap] — REMEDIATED: FR-021 adds no-op handling for zero tiles (no draw calls, no errors)

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK060 Is "color-coded overlay" sufficiently defined (solid fill vs pattern overlay)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001] — Dual-coding: solid color + pattern overlay, both defined in FR-001 and data-model
- [x] CHK061 Is "brief flash effect" sufficiently specified (what color, full tile or border)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003] — REMEDIATED: FR-003 now specifies "white overlay flash at the tile's health category color"
- [x] CHK062 Are there conflicts between viewport culling requirement and 60 FPS target? [Conflict, Spec §FR-009, §SC-002, Gap] — REMEDIATED: FR-009 adds graceful degradation (simplified rendering) when visible tiles exceed 1,000
- [x] CHK063 Is the relationship between opacity and accessibility patterns clear? [Ambiguity, Gap] — REMEDIATED: FR-001 adds "Pattern opacity MUST remain at minimum 0.7 regardless of overlay opacity setting"
- [x] CHK064 Are configuration hot-reload behavior requirements defined? [Gap, Spec §SC-003] — REMEDIATED: FR-005 adds hot-reload detection and immediate application; FR-019 adds atomic config application

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
